title: Equivalent question
text: Is there a real number that when you square it you get -3?

title: Negative bases cause problems
text: You cannot take the square root of a negative number.

title: Concusion
text: There is no real number equal to $${\left(-3\right)}^{\frac{1}{2}}=\sqrt{-3}$$. If you are interested in learning more about complex numbers, go check out the Student Learning Center! And bring a friend. :)
